inj.note: Skattebo was able to manage one limited practice (Friday) this week, and while head coach John Harbaugh told reporters the New York Post that the Giants are "keeping the door open" for the running back to play in Week 9, his official listing implies it's more likely just ajar. In any case, if Skattebo ends up sitting out Sunday, Devin Singletary likely will serve as New York's lead runner, with Greg Desrosiers and potentially practice-squad members Eric Gray and Phil Mafah in line for work behind him.

news.h: Giants' Cam Skattebo doubtful vs. Eagles; Malik Nabers 'full go'
news.d: Giants running back Cam Skattebo is unlikely to play against the Eagles on Sunday, but receiver Malik Nabers is expected to be a "full go" without limitations.

news.h: Giants' Cam Skattebo, John Harbaugh object to lowering helmet penalty
news.d: Giants coach John Harbaugh and Cam Skattebo took issue with a first-quarter penalty call Sunday against Houston, when the running back was flagged for unnecessary roughness for impermissible helmet contact.
